sales_call: A: Thanks for hopping on, I know you're busy this week.
B: No problem at all, happy to be here.
A: So last time we spoke you mentioned budget was a concern for Q3, is that still the case?
B: Yeah, honestly the budget got tighter, not looser.
A: Understood. What if we broke the rollout into two phases instead of one?
B: That could work. I don't think we can commit to the full package right now though.
A: Totally fair. Could you send me the updated headcount numbers by Friday?
B: Sure, I'll get that over to you.
A: Great. Let's go with the phased proposal then, I'll draft it up.
B: Sounds good. Oh, before I forget, has the security review finished on your end?
A: Not yet, that's still with our compliance team.
B: Okay, please keep me posted on that, it's a blocker for our legal team.
standup_meeting: A: Okay let's get started, quick round robin.
B: I finished the STK push retry logic yesterday, no blockers.
A: Nice. Did the M-Pesa callback timeout get fixed too?
B: Not yet, I'll pick that up today.
C: I'm still stuck on the cart UX overhaul, the unit conversion is buggy.
C: When you switch units mid-cart the totals don't recalculate.
A: Okay, let's make sure that's fixed before the demo on Thursday.
B: Switching gears, has anyone looked at the receipt sharing bug on Android?
A: I haven't, can you file a ticket for it?
B: Yeah I'll do that after standup.
interview_practice: A: Tell me about a time you disagreed with a technical decision.
B: Sure. On a past project the team wanted to use a synchronous queue and I pushed back.
A: What was your concern with that approach?
B: My concern was that it wouldn't scale past a few hundred concurrent users.
A: How did you resolve the disagreement?
B: I put together a small benchmark and shared the numbers with the team.
A: And what happened after that?
B: We ended up deciding to go with an async approach instead.
A: Great, let's move on to a different topic. How do you handle tight deadlines?
B: I try to scope ruthlessly and communicate early if something's at risk.
